name: Flaunch PositionManager
mechanic: Runs Flaunch memecoin launches and fills fee inventory via an internal swap pool.
plain: The core hook for the Flaunch launch platform. It manages memecoin pool creation and runs an internal swap pool that fills fee inventory against incoming trades.
rules: Manages memecoin pool creation for the Flaunch platform.
An internal swap pool converts collected fees against incoming trades.
